# Private callback element result

Owned Java 8 corpus: a real private static helper binds its sole Object result formal through a complete binary callback accepting a fixed known context and producing that formal. The actual return comes from separate opaque state. Immutable callers observe late String casts, arbitrary and null results, callback result independence, context mutation and snapshots, repeated calls, initialization and callback failures.

Source and SDK-input variants independently account for all original definitions, compile all generated Java and compare complete metadata and Exceptions. The same observer must reject Signature-only controls and eight wrong programs without changing original bytecode or observer bytes.
